name: linux-since-nonutc-offset-normalized
description: `--since` accepts an RFC3339 timestamp with a non-UTC offset; it must be normalized to the correct UTC instant before comparison (DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | AdjustToUniversal). The mock's fixture-since discussion has one WIN message at server-time 2020-06-01T10:00:00Z. With --since 2020-06-01T14:00:00+05:30 (== 08:30:00Z, BEFORE the message) wait must MATCH and exit 0; a naive parse that dropped the +05:30 offset would treat --since as 14:00Z (AFTER the message) and time out (exit 2). Exit 0 proves offset-aware comparison. Version guard passes because fixture-since advertises the running build.
